messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the 3/18 GPU surge postmortem — we need to lock owners and timelines for the remediation items (quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom planning). Who can own what?
priya: I can take quota increases and the request to infra for a soft limit bump. ETA end of week to get PR + cost estimate. :thumbsup:
ben: I can pair with Priya on the cost model. Will run a sim on the last 30 days of traffic and post results tomorrow.
maya: Ben, can you also add a short note on burn vs. request size so we can propose a safe buffer (20%?) to finance.
sasha: I'll own scheduler tuning (priority queues + preemption thresholds). Plan: prototype config change in staging Wednesday, run canary with low-risk jobs.
ugo: I'll pick up headroom planning and runbook updates — created a checklist in the playbook. Need owners for the recurring detection alerts (ops-bot integration).
ops-bot: New alert rule created: "gpu-lbt-headroom" triggers when rolling free-GPU < 15% for 10m. Linked to #oncall.
maya: Good — put the playbook PR in the same repo under docs/incidents so it's easy to link from alerts. Ugo, can you get that PR by Friday?
ugo: Yep, aiming for Thursday EOD. Will include example response steps and who to page at 10/20/30 min intervals.
priya: For the quota request — question for finance: do we submit a temporary burst request or a permanent quota increase? Suggest temporary until 2 weeks after scheduler changes.
ben: I'll model both and include expected spend delta.
sasha: For the scheduler tuning specifics, here's what I'll try in staging:
```
- increase preemption threshold from 0.2 -> 0.35
- enable priority-queue fast-path for <50ms enqueue latency jobs
- limit continuous-batch size to 64 -> 48 for latency-sensitive classes
```
maya: Please capture the perf metrics (p95 latency, queue length, tail GPU util) and add to the canary ticket.
priya: Filing the quota ticket now: https://go/redwood/tickets/INC-3821 (temp-burst requested). Assigning to @infra-provisioning.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-3821 created and linked to this thread.
ben: Early sim results: a 15% buffer reduces the number of surge denials by ~82% in our sample window. Will post full table in INC-3821.
maya: Nice. Owners recap: Priya -> quota request & finance coord (ETA Fri), Ben -> cost sims and numbers (ETA Thu), Sasha -> scheduler tuning + canary (staging Wed, canary Thu), Ugo -> headroom playbook + alert wiring (ETA Thu). I'll run a 30-min sync tomorrow to confirm progress.
priya: One more ask — can we add a metric to the dashboard for "continuous preemption events"? Helps validate scheduler change.
sasha: Yup, I'll add that to the canary dashboard.
maya: Thanks all. If anything slips, drop a note here. I'll post the sync invite in 5. :calendar:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Postmortem follow-up sync at 2026-03-24T15:00Z.
